newsitem.title: USA: Reliv stock off on short selling-analyst.
newsitem.headline: Reliv stock off on short selling-analyst.

text.p: Reliv International Inc shares traded down 1-1/8 to 6-3/8, after reaching an intra-day low of 5-7/8, amid short selling of the stock, Cohig & Associates analyst Ed Larkin said.
The analyst added that Reliv, which recently traded over $12 a share, has come under "some short-selling pressure" in recent weeks.

Larkin said he continues to rate the stock an accumulate, adding he expects Reliv to benefit from the introduction of a new functional food product, Arthaffect. Reliv has said Arthaffect has been clinically shown to help combat degenerative joint disease
Since Arthaffect was introduced "the indications are company has had a couple of its best weeks ever," Larkin added.
A company spokesman, meanwhile, said he did not know why the stock traded lower today.
